role: Declares the one-break harvest API of harvestdrops.c: the 3x3x3 cell context, the case (held stack, silk/fortune levels, exhaustion, world seed, Math.random stream) and the result (cells after, held stack after, stats, dropped entities).

structs.name: hd_cell
structs.java: a block id and metadata at one position

structs.name: hd_case
structs.java: the break's inputs: position, world cells, the player's held ItemStack, the enchant levels, FoodStats.foodExhaustionLevel, the world Random seed and Math.random

structs.name: hd_result
structs.java: the break's outputs: world cells, held stack, exhaustion, the three StatList counters, spawned EntityItems

gpu: line 65, struct hd_case: carries a jrand pointer to the shared Math.random stream
notes: HD_MAX_ENTS is drops.h's DROPS_MAX_ENTS, so the result's entity array is fixed size.
